rationale.runtimeAssets: Budget v3 records the intentional P5.2 FrontierOS vertical-slice architecture. Main had already reached 176 index runtime references after P5.2.10; P5.2.11 reaches 180. The cap is rebaselined to 192 so the remaining canonical app migrations can land without silently violating release policy. Any increase beyond 192 requires an explicit bundling/consolidation phase rather than another budget-only change.
rationale.bytes: JavaScript, CSS, transfer-size, DOM-size, render-loop, and per-asset byte ceilings remain unchanged; the asset-count rebaseline does not waive payload or runtime-performance constraints.
